generator: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 (eleven_text_to_sound_v2) via the project owner's ElevenLabs account
processing: 70 Hz high-pass and 11 kHz low-pass, a one-second equal-power crossfade from each take's tail into its head (so it loops with no seam), levelled to about -32 LUFS, 96 kbps MP3.

assets.prompt: Small clear stream babbling over stones, close, gentle trickle and soft gurgle, steady and continuous, calm, no birds, no wind, no voices
Wide river flowing steadily past its banks, soft rushing water with gentle lapping, continuous, calm, no birds, no wind, no voices
Waterfall pouring into a rock pool, deep steady roar with bright splashing, continuous, no birds, no wind, no voices

notes: Alderwing mixes the three by distance, size and speed of the nearest running water (listen() in world_water_core.js).
Small quick water babbles, broad water rushes, and a waterfall roars from further off the bigger its drop.
